name: @local/wagmi-v1-to-v2-codemod
description: Codemod package for migrating React-based wagmi projects from v1 to v2.

scripts.test:config: npx --yes codemod jssg test -l tsx ./scripts/migrate-config.ts ./tests/migrate-config --strictness ast
scripts.test:hooks: npx --yes codemod jssg test -l tsx ./scripts/migrate-imports-and-hooks.ts ./tests/migrate-imports-and-hooks --strictness loose
scripts.test:connectors: npx --yes codemod jssg test -l tsx ./scripts/migrate-connectors.ts ./tests/migrate-connectors --strictness loose
scripts.test:report: npx --yes codemod jssg test -l tsx ./scripts/write-report.ts ./tests/report --strictness strict
scripts.test: npm run test:deps && npm run test:config && npm run test:hooks && npm run test:connectors && npm run test:report
